operations.inspect: Read document details and extract text from up to five selected pages.

operations.search_text: Find a phrase in the PDF text and return page locations.
operations.read_lines: Read existing text lines and their line numbers on one page.
operations.list_forms: List interactive form fields, options and current values.

operations.merge: Combine up to five uploaded PDFs in order.
operations.rotate: Rotate selected pages by 90, 180 or 270 degrees.
operations.delete: Delete selected pages from the copy.
operations.move: Move selected pages to a new position.
operations.insert_blank: Insert a blank page, with optional dimensions.
operations.insert_from_pdf: Insert selected pages from another uploaded PDF.
operations.replace_from_pdf: Replace selected page content with pages from another uploaded PDF.
operations.extract: Save only the selected pages as a new PDF.
operations.crop: Set crop margins in points. Cropping changes the visible area.
operations.page_labels: Set viewer page labels such as i, ii, iii or A-1, A-2.

operations.set_metadata: Set the title, author, subject or keywords.
operations.add_text: Place text using page coordinates and supported Western European characters.
operations.replace_text_line: Replace a supported PDF text line after checking its exact original text.
operations.add_bookmark: Add a bookmark pointing to a page.
operations.delete_bookmark: Delete a bookmark and its children.
operations.add_note: Add a comment note at a page position.
operations.add_header_footer: Add a centered header or footer, with optional page-number tokens.
operations.remove_page_marks: Remove supported headers, footers, watermarks or backgrounds.

operations.reset_form: Reset interactive fields to their defaults.
operations.flatten: Bake form fields or comments into the PDF page content.

operations.split_every: Split into PDFs of N pages each, up to 20 outputs.
operations.split_before: Start new PDFs at specified pages, up to 20 outputs.
operations.render_page: Render a page to a PNG at 36–144 DPI.
operations.optimize: Create an optimized PDF copy. The result may have a similar file size.
